# France

[global-law](../) / France

7 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 6 case law). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 100% | 0% | 67% |

National law is close to complete. All 76 codes Légifrance lists as in force are there, plus the 1958 Constitution, and about 118,853 LEGI texts with articles in force, each with its in-force history. Two spot-checked 2026 amendments match Légifrance. Case law is strong for the Conseil constitutionnel, the Cour de cassation and the Conseil d'État, but thin below them: the 'tribunaux administratifs' repository is 98% CAA decisions (1,023 real TA decisions), and the cours d'appel stop at 2023-12-22.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
